title: Implement documented site design
description: Wire DESIGN.md into all four static pages through one shared token-driven stylesheet. Preserve property content, facts, navigation, imagery, and restrained incumbent identity.
design: Add styles.css with documented colors, typography, spacing, square components, responsive behavior, and visible focus. Replace duplicated inline CSS and inline style attributes with shared classes; add viewport metadata.
acceptance_criteria: All HTML pages load styles.css; no page-level style blocks remain; documented tokens and core components are represented; navigation and content remain intact; desktop and mobile render without horizontal overflow; detector and structural checks pass.
close_reason: Implemented shared token-driven stylesheet across four pages; preserved content and imagery; added responsive layouts, contained tables, focus states, image metadata, and passing structural/browser verification.
